falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the 2019 peak level (e.g., $150.32) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the historical peak would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by indicating a confirmed bullish trend, contradicting the pattern's implied bearish blowoff structure.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average on at least 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would refute the 'UNKNOWN' verdict by demonstrating clear market participation inconsistent with a consolidation phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes below its 50-day moving average by 2.5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed bearish crossover would contradict the pattern's implied bullish divergence, directly invalidating the current HOLD signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
